description: This file defines the InstalledDistribution class, which represents an installed package in the pip package management system. It includes properties and methods related to package metadata and integration with the pip internal architecture.

classes.name: InstalledDistribution
classes.description: Represents an installed package, providing methods to access its metadata and state within pip.

methods.name: Optional[str] build_tracker_id(self)
methods.description: Returns an optional string identifier for build tracking; currently always returns None.

methods.name: BaseDistribution get_metadata_distribution(self)
methods.description: Returns the package's distribution metadata as a BaseDistribution object, asserting the package is satisfied by some requirement.

methods.name: None prepare_distribution_metadata( self, finder: PackageFinder, build_isolation: bool, check_build_deps: bool, )
methods.description: Placeholder method for preparing distribution metadata; accepts a PackageFinder, and flags for build isolation and dependency checks.
